messages:
emily_marketing: quick heads-up — eu-west hosted inference is seeing degraded embeddings throughput and higher tail latency. marketing needs a short customer alert + statuspage copy. can we get confirmed scope and timing? :thinking_face:

raj_ops: we're seeing elevated queue times on dedicated pools serving embeddings; looks like a batch/kv-cache regression after last runtime tweak. investigating now. will confirm affected regions + models in ~15m. @emily_marketing

sarah_support: support queue already has a handful of tickets for slower responses. suggest we route high-spend orgs to priority support email first, then public status update. i'll draft canned replies.

alex_product: for status copy, propose we use 'partial degradation' language and include workaround (region switch / smaller model). draft below — feel free to edit: 
```
We are investigating partial degradation of embeddings generation in the eu-west region affecting response times for some models. No data loss is suspected. Our engineers are working on mitigation; we'll post updates every 30 minutes. Suggested workaround: route requests to eu-north or use model-variant "embed-lite" for time-sensitive requests.
```

emily_marketing: this is good. timing proposal: 1) immediate private email to customers with > $25k ARR and those on Dedicated/Private (within 10m), 2) post 'Investigating' to status page + public comms in 20m once scope confirmed, 3) follow-up update when mitigation is in staging or within 60m. for the webinar tomorrow — put a 30-min hold and be ready to pivot to a brief incident Q&A if customers want it.

mike_sales: pls tag any accounts flagged as at-risk in the CRM. route to enterprise-sales@ for immediate outreach. we need heads-up if any demo customers impacted.

raj_ops: confirmed impacted: eu-west1, some dedicated pools serving embeddings-heavy workloads, and models: text-embed-xxl + text-embed-large. mitigation: rollback recent kv-cache change to reduce queueing; aiming for staged rollback in ~20-30m. will update.

incident_bot: Incident created INC-2026-0423 — severity: P2, initial status: investigating. playbook: ops -> rollback attempt -> staging verification -> gradual restore.

emily_marketing: final statuspage copy (short form) for publish in 20m: 
```
Title: Investigating partial degradation of embeddings in eu-west
Body: We are investigating increased latency for embeddings requests in the eu-west region impacting some customers. Engineers have identified a regression and are working on a rollback. No customer data has been compromised. Next update in 30 minutes or when we have mitigation progress. Workaround: try eu-north or use the embed-lite model variant.
```

sarah_support: i'll load the canned reply template into Zendesk + Intercom snippets and coordinate PM to send targeted emails to enterprise contacts. drafting email subject options: 
- "Redwood update: temporary embeddings latency in eu-west"
- "Action required: embeddings performance — workaround & ETA"

emily_marketing: agree on first subject. also prepping short tweet/thread and a webinar hold note: "Tomorrow's webinar will proceed; we'll start with 10m incident update and Q&A. If you'd prefer a reschedule DM us."

mike_sales: can someone ping me as soon as rollback is verified? i'll reach out to top 10 accounts proactively.

raj_ops: ack — will ping when staging shows normal tail latency. timeline looks like 30-45m for rollback + verification.

emily_marketing: thank you team. i'll queue the private email now and hold public publish until scope confirms in 20. tagging: @raj_ops @sarah_support @mike_sales. :thumbsup:
